pages.text: Far out in the endless ocean lies a mysterious $(l)Island$().$(br)$(br)Grab a boat, bring your relics, and set sail into the deep seas to find it.

$(l)Night Ritual$()$(br)$(br)Once you reach the island, $(l)you must wait until nightfall$().$(br)$(br)Only under the night sky does the ancient altar awaken, allowing you to enchant your rod with unique powers.
